title: The Floor Gives Way
description: The boards here are dark with damp, bowed slightly in the middle. You hear them before you feel them — a low creak beneath your weight that drops in pitch. One step more and the groan becomes a crack. The gap below is black and deeper than it should be. Yet, in the far depths of the dark, you see a feeble light

choices.label: Peek into the shadows
choices.description: Shift your weight to the edges where the joists may still hold.

success.narrative: You find solid footing along the skirting and ease past the worst of it.

failure.narrative: The dark beowA plank snaps beneath your heel and your leg drops through, the splintered edge tearing as you haul yourself clear.

choices.label: Run straight across before it collapses
choices.description: Cross fast. Speed before the rot can catch you.

success.narrative: You're across before the worst boards know you were there.

failure.narrative: You are fast but the floor is faster — your ankle turns in a shattering gap and you hit the far wall hard.

choices.label: Find another route through the hall
choices.description: Backtrack and look for a path that avoids the damaged section entirely.

success.narrative: Behind a collapsed shelf you find a narrow service passage — cold, low, but solid underfoot.

failure.narrative: There is no other way. You have wasted time circling back, and the hall feels smaller for it.

visual.alt_text: A dim entrance hall with a buckled section of flooring at its centre, dark water stains spreading outward from a jagged split in the boards. Blackness visible beneath, with a faint glow emanating from the depths.
